definitions.explanation: To receive someone who is arriving, especially as a host.
To go somewhere to meet someone and bring them back.
To arrive at a certain time, age, or stage.

examples.japanese: お{客|きゃく}さんを{迎|むか}える。
{駅|えき}まで{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く。
examples.english: Go to the station to pick someone up.
examples.notes: {迎|むか}えに{行|い}く = go to pick up

examples.japanese: {新年|しんねん}を{迎|むか}える。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{迎|むか}える (welcome X).

ASPECT: ている indicates completed action or state. {迎|むか}えている = 'has welcomed' or 'is welcoming.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・お{客|きゃく}さんを{迎|むか}える (welcome guests)
・{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く (go to pick up)
・{迎|むか}えに{来|く}る (come to pick up)
・{新年|しんねん}を{迎|むか}える (welcome the new year)
・{誕生日|たんじょうび}を{迎|むか}える (reach one's birthday)
・{危機|きき}を{迎|むか}える (face a crisis)

RELATED:
・お{迎|むか}え (pickup, welcoming—noun, polite)
・{出迎|でむか}え (going out to meet—noun)
